---
title: Connect ChatGPT
description: Add WriteStack to ChatGPT as a custom MCP connector and sign in with OAuth.
---

ChatGPT connects with OAuth. Custom connectors in ChatGPT need developer mode turned on for your account or workspace.

## Steps

1. In ChatGPT, open **Settings → Apps & Connectors** and turn on **Developer mode** under **Advanced settings**.
2. Choose **Create** to add a connector. Name it `WriteStack` and paste the endpoint:
   ```text
   https://www.writestack.io/api/mcp/mcp
   ```
3. Set authentication to **OAuth** and save. ChatGPT opens WriteStack. Sign in and approve access.
4. In a new chat, pick the WriteStack connector and ask, for example: "Draft three Notes about my latest post."

ChatGPT's menus and plan requirements change often. If a step looks different, follow the [step-by-step guide with screenshots](https://guides.writestack.io/?post=2-guides-add-mcp-gpt).

## If it doesn't work

| Problem | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| No option to add a custom connector | Your ChatGPT plan or workspace doesn't allow developer mode. Ask your workspace admin, or use [Claude](/docs/build/connect/claude). |
| "MCP access is not available on your current plan" | Your WriteStack plan doesn't include MCP. See [plans and limits](/docs/account/plans-and-limits). |
| Notes were scheduled but didn't post | Open WriteStack, go to **My Notes → Scheduled notes** and click **Sync N scheduled notes to Substack**. See [Sync](/docs/using/concepts/sync). |
